# Lemniscate

> A local-first AI reading room where documents become living, interactive experiences. Everything you read, annotate, and write stays on your device; AI companions run on free models you connect yourself.

## About

Lemniscate is a client-only web application (no account, no server-side storage). It ingests PDF, EPUB, DOCX, PPTX, Markdown, TXT, and HTML documents directly in the browser, parses them into chapters with an offline NLP engine ("Anchor" / LOA), and offers three AI companions that work either fully offline (extractive, grounded, citation-first) or with a free model key you supply.

- URL: https://lemniscate.app
- Type: web application, single page, client-rendered
- Cost: free; bring-your-own-key for live AI (optional)
- Privacy: all documents and keys stay in the browser (IndexedDB / in-memory); keys are never persisted

## Key features

- Library: local-first document storage (IndexedDB), cover shelf, search
- Reader: typography controls, eight serif stacks, three reading themes, annotations, bookmarks, in-document search, focus mode, scene view
- Luma: margin chat companion that answers with citations from the open book; runs offline via the Anchor engine or streams from a connected model
- Ouro: study-set companion that builds summaries, themes, characters, vocabulary, quizzes, and flashcards (Zod-validated when a model is connected)
- Ankaa: long-form writing companion with a background job queue that turns prompts into new chapters of your book
- Insights: reading analytics and activity history
- Offline engine (LOA / Anchor): TextRank extractive summarization, bigram keyword motifs, character detection with dialogue attribution, cloze quizzes with sourced distractors, passage retrieval, and mojibake-aware ingestion cleaning

## AI providers

Bring one key, get that provider's free models. Keys live in memory only (cleared on refresh), never in storage:

- OpenRouter: aggregated `:free` catalog (Nemotron, DeepSeek, Llama, Qwen, Kimi and other free variants as offered)
- Google Gemini: free tier from AI Studio (Gemini 3.8 Flash family)
- xAI Grok: grok models with promotional credits
- Groq: free tier, ultra-fast inference
- Mistral: free experiment tier
- Cerebras: free daily quota (Qwen flagship class)

All providers speak an OpenAI-compatible API from the browser; no server proxy is involved.

## Documentation

- Reading room entry: https://lemniscate.app/ (the application)
- In-app Settings: provider setup, key entry, model catalogs, per-companion model choice
- In-app Insights: reading analytics and history

## Policies

- No accounts, no tracking, no server-side user data
- Documents are processed entirely on-device
- AI requests go directly from the browser to the provider you choose
